subject: W3-B Task 2 provider-independent payment evidence and reconciliation authority (repaired)

results.suite: W3-B Task 2: Provider-independent payment evidence and reconciliation authority on real PostgreSQL
invariantsVerified: Payment worker cannot select synthetic monetary authority (SYNTHETIC_TEST eliminated from deployable schemas and SQL procedures)
Payment worker cannot choose arbitrary expected amount (derived strictly from stays_quotes.total_paise; null for current accepted-offer quotes)
RAZORPAY attempt without exact quote+hold fails closed
Quote A + Hold B mismatch rejected with PAYMENT_QUOTE_HOLD_MISMATCH
Foreign holder principal rejected with PAYMENT_PRINCIPAL_MISMATCH
Replay with same command ID but changed parameters rejected with PAYMENT_COMMAND_CONFLICT by comparing incoming immutable request fields against stored attempt
Same event ID with mutated event type quarantined with MUTATED_EVENT_TYPE
Same event ID with mutated amount quarantined with MUTATED_EVENT_AMOUNT
Same event ID with mutated currency quarantined with MUTATED_EVENT_CURRENCY
Same event ID with mutated payment/order ref quarantined with MUTATED_PAYMENT_REF / MUTATED_ORDER_REF
Same event ID replayed against different attempt quarantined with EVENT_REPLAYED_AGAINST_DIFFERENT_ATTEMPT
MATCHED_CAPTURE + recordPaymentUnknown preserves MATCHED_CAPTURE and does not regress to UNKNOWN
MATCHED_CAPTURE + PAYMENT_UNKNOWN event preserves MATCHED_CAPTURE and does not regress to UNKNOWN
Captured state + stale AUTHORIZED does not regress
Captured state + FAILED preserves capture truth (matched_at timestamp intact) and enters RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / OUT_OF_ORDER_EVENT
Missing payable authority strictly flags RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / PAYABLE_AUTHORITY_MISSING and cannot become MATCHED_CAPTURE
Amount mismatch flags RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / AMOUNT_MISMATCH with both expected and reported amounts preserved
Capture after hold expiry records event into RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / HOLD_EXPIRED without resurrecting hold or creating reservation
Zero canonical reservations or orders created across all Task 2 paths
Foreign runtime roles denied execution without restricted worker privileges
Guest/web role (encho_stays_web) has zero raw DML permissions on canonical payment tables
Identical provider event replayed against same attempt returns DUPLICATE_IGNORED with replayed=true
DISPOSABLE TEST FIXTURE ONLY: trusted test fixture authority amount Y + provider evidence Y -> MATCHED_CAPTURE

Committed exact command replay recovered across hold expiry by comparing stored immutable command fields before mutable eligibility checks (replayed=true); mutations rejected with PAYMENT_COMMAND_CONFLICT
New command against expired hold fails closed with PAYMENT_HOLD_NOT_ACTIVE
Retrying committed command with mutated parameters after hold expiry conflicts (PAYMENT_COMMAND_CONFLICT)
Provider event origin mismatch quarantined with PROVIDER_ORIGIN_MISMATCH without advancing attempt state
Provider event order ref mismatch quarantined with PROVIDER_ORDER_REF_MISMATCH without advancing attempt state
Matching provider event order ref processes normally
Case A: Redundant second capture evidence with same underlying provider payment identity preserves MATCHED_CAPTURE without duplicate effect or state regression
Case B: Conflicting second capture identity enters RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / CAPTURE_CONFLICT while preserving matched_at timestamp
First capture without durable provider payment reference strictly flags RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / CAPTURE_IDENTITY_MISSING and never establishes MATCHED_CAPTURE
Distinct capture event with NULL payment reference arriving after MATCHED_CAPTURE flags CAPTURE_CONFLICT rather than redundant capture
RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED is sticky across recordPaymentUnknown, PAYMENT_UNKNOWN, and PAYMENT_FAILED without clearing primary reconciliation reason
matched_at timestamp and capture evidence remain intact across later out-of-order, failed, and unknown events

security: Dedicated encho_payment_worker role with NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION; RLS forced on all canonical payment tables; web and guest roles have zero raw DML permissions; narrow SECURITY DEFINER procedures execute verified mutations.
conclusion: Provider-independent payment evidence and reconciliation authority is repaired. Lost-response command replays are recovered before mutable quote/hold checks across hold expiry by comparing stored immutable command fields, incoming provider events are strictly bound to attempt origin and order reference with fail-closed quarantine for mismatches, capture events strictly require non-empty provider payment references to establish or preserve MATCHED_CAPTURE (otherwise entering CAPTURE_IDENTITY_MISSING or CAPTURE_CONFLICT), RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED is sticky against later unknown, failed, or authorized events, matched_at truth is preserved across all later events, and exactly zero reservations are created.
limitations: No real money movement, remote Neon mutation, live Razorpay API, STAAH integration or public checkout was executed. W3-A reservation finalization was intentionally not composed with payment capture in this task.
